topic: Sensorimotor integration is enhanced in dancers and musicians

sources.title: Sensorimotor integration is enhanced in dancers and musicians
sources.authors: Karpati FJ, Giacosa C, Foster NE, Penhune VB, Hyde KL.

findings.finding: Dancers outperformed musicians and controls specifically on a whole-body dance imitation task.
findings.quote: Dancers performed better than musicians and controls on a dance imitation task (involving whole-body movement)

findings.finding: Musicians showed superior performance compared to dancers and controls on melody discrimination and rhythm synchronization tasks.
findings.quote: musicians performed better than dancers and controls on a musical melody discrimination task as well as on a rhythm synchronization task (involving finger tapping)

principle: Long-term intensive training in dance or music leads to distinct enhancements in sensorimotor skills tailored to the specific domain.
for_the_teacher: Include whole-body imitation tasks to leverage and develop sensorimotor integration skills in learners.
